Explain how a VPN works in simple words
5:24 AM

A VPN is a private tunnel between your device and the internet. Everything you send is locked first, goes through the tunnel to a VPN company's computer, and only then goes out to the website you wanted.

Two things follow from that:

Your internet provider and public Wi-Fi owner see only locked data going to the VPN, not which sites you visit.
The websites see the VPN's location instead of yours, so you look like you're somewhere else.

A VPN doesn't make you invisible. The VPN company can still see your traffic, so pick one you trust. It also doesn't protect you from fake websites or dodgy downloads.
